If you tell me **one** of the following, I’ll output the exact 3 lines in the right format:

1) the command you used for the last run (or a snippet from your `README`), or  
2) the name of the runner/CLI (e.g., `aub`, `invoke`, `make`, `python -m ...`, `hydra`, `dvc`, etc.), and where configs live, or  
3) what “next” should accomplish (e.g., “reproduce champion”, “launch new sweep”, “promote/deploy”, “export artifacts”).


```bash
<run_cmd> --init_from db08d79b484756ab --mode sweep --n_trials <N>

```

### Option C — Promote/export the current champion
```bash

<run_cmd> --mode tag --run_hash db08d79b484756ab --tag champion

```
